text:
devon: FYI planning a dawn micro-canary for quant-v5-small + slim-matmul at 05:30 PT tomorrow. target: low-traffic slice, region gating, and a short manual rollback runbook.

sam: sounds good. what slice and rollout cadence?

devon: start 0.2% for 15m, then 1% for 20m, then 5% if green. will exclude eu-west until we confirm memory behaviour there.

elena: please add thermal + memory alarms for the first 30m in each region. last time eu-west saw pagefaults after warmup.

anya: propose automated guard rails:
```
# auto rollback if any 3-minute window shows:
p95_latency increase > 35% OR mem_usage increase > 20% OR cpu_smoothed > 80% OR request_error_rate > 0.75%
```
Hook to abort if any trigger holds 3m.

sam: add a quick canary smoke set for quality: 4 classification prompts + 4 generative style checks. if any exact-match failure > 2/8, flag for manual review.

devon: agreed. deploy-bot, can you schedule but keep eu-west blocked?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary 1758889999 for 2025-07-04T05:30:00-07:00. slice plan: 0.2% -> 1% -> 5%. routing: ALL_REGIONS EXCEPT eu-west. auto-rollback hooks attached per config. Preflight: artifact signed.

ops: we have ~12% spare capacity in the morning window but will reserve a 40m quiesce from 05:15-05:55 PT (no big batch jobs). posting now.

elena: runbook for manual pin/rollback:
- abort: `deploy-bot abort 1758889999`
- pin fallback: `rbctl pin runtime:slim-matmul@v3 --regions eu-west --ttl 8h`
- clear pins after stable: `rbctl unpin runtime:slim-matmul@v3 --regions eu-west`

anya: I updated the telemetry dashboard and created alert `dawn-quant-thermals` with the triggers listed. Also added a small perf probe that exercises long-context KV to catch cache regressions.

sam: can we bake a short note in release notes about fallback and pinned regions? product usually wants that to email customers.

devon: will draft: "dawn micro-canary: quant-v5-small + slim-matmul. fallback: quant-v4 + slim-matmul@v3 in eu-west. auto-rollback on perf/regressions; manual pin available."

ops: posting quiesce window now. also verifying that infra autoscaler won't trigger during the slice.

elena: one more: if we see high memory creep but pass latency, hold the rollout and escalate to runtime-ops. memory-led hold = manual rollback only.

anya: updated alert to include mem-creep hold rule (manual). added runbook link: https://confluence.internal/release/dawn-quant (internal).

devon: final checklist: 1) deploy-bot scheduled, 2) dashboards & alerts live, 3) ops quiesce posted, 4) release note draft in product channel, 5) oncall lined up.

sam: oncall: me 05:15-07:00 PT.

deploy-bot: kickoff will run at scheduled time. preflight OK.

(END)
